task_sources.name: ClinicalReTrial: clinical trial outcome simulation environment (construction prototype)
TrialBench trial failure reason identification dataset (CC-BY-4.0)
ClinicalTrials.gov registry records (protocol fields added to TrialBench)

metric.description: Macro-average ROC-AUC over three failure modes (poor enrollment, safety, lack of efficacy): for each mode, ROC-AUC of pred_success_prob against the hidden outcome on that mode's test trials (label 1 = success), then the unweighted mean. Higher is better; 0.5 is no skill. The authoritative result is this raw value. The linear display transform maps the constant-prediction bottom line 0.5 to 0 and the published ClinicalReTrial predictor 0.6924 to 1000, without capping either end. Invalid submissions are not ranked.

baseline.name: ClinicalReTrial outcome predictor: one LightGBM model per failure mode over BioBERT, MPNN/ADMET, GRAM/ICD and tabular features
